why_not_the_same_gap: the reviewed capacity_confusion defect keeps out_size/data_size as parameters of the same function render(); the deterministic capacity strategy already reasons about those register-allocated capacities. The M2 cross-function gap is different: the capacity is in a caller frame and the sink sits in another function, so no same-function value is available at the sink.

stripped_image_observation.note: vuln-capacity-param-x86_64.elf is a stripped image (-s): the prototype is anchored on authoritative symbols, so it only reconstructs the entry point and direct-call-target functions and finds no copy sink. The deterministic capacity strategy works from scanned code blocks instead of symbols; stripped-binary function discovery is an explicit M2 limitation, not a capability claim.
